notes: Large-source-unit check: `אֲשֶׁר ... בָהּ` → *wherein* is genuinely indivisible. The one English word carries the relation, the preposition and the resumption alike, the suffix agrees with and points at the antecedent `דַּרְכְּכֶם`, and rule 22 records the same three-morpheme unit in twenty-one places; the unit is retained, headed on the relative.
`נֹכַח יְהוָה` is the predicate of the verbless clause, so the construction-supplied copula joins the preposition under rule 49, discontinuous under rule 25.
